cases.description: Passing a null string should cause the factory to reject the request and throw a NullPointerException (the overload forwards to getSchema(String, null) which validates the argument).
An empty schema string does not represent a valid JSON/YAML document; the method should detect this early and throw an IllegalArgumentException.
A simple, valid JSON schema supplied as a raw string should be parsed successfully and return a JsonSchema object.
A valid YAML schema supplied as a raw string must be recognized, parsed by the internal YAMLMapper and result in a JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: non-null JsonSchema instance with resolved reference
cases.description: The main schema contains a $ref to a second schema located on the classpath; the factory must resolve the reference without throwing an exception.

cases.expected: non-null JsonSchema instance with resolved reference
cases.description: A YAML schema containing a $ref to another YAML schema on the classpath should be loaded and the reference resolved.
Malformed JSON should cause the underlying Jackson parser to throw a JsonParseException which propagates as an IllegalArgumentException.
Malformed YAML should trigger a parsing exception (JsonParseException) from the YAMLMapper.
A schema location ending with an unsupported extension (e.g., .txt) must be rejected with an IllegalArgumentException.
A syntactically invalid URI should cause the factory to wrap the URISyntaxException in an IllegalArgumentException.
When the supplied classpath location cannot be found, the method must throw an IllegalArgumentException indicating the resource is missing.

group: Valid JSON Schema from Classpath (JSON file)

cases.description: A correctly formatted JSON schema placed on the classpath should be located, parsed and returned as a JsonSchema object.

group: Valid JSON Schema from Classpath (YAML file)

cases.description: A correctly formatted YAML schema on the classpath should be located, parsed by YAMLMapper and returned as a JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: same JsonSchema instance on subsequent calls
cases.description: Calling getSchema with the same classpath location multiple times should return the cached JsonSchema instance (identity equality).
The factory should reject URIs with unsupported schemes (e.g., ftp) and throw an IllegalArgumentException.
When the URI points to a remote resource that cannot be reached, the underlying I/O error should be wrapped and reported as an IllegalArgumentException.
A schema containing a $ref to a non‑existent classpath resource must cause the factory to throw an IllegalArgumentException indicating the reference cannot be resolved.
A schema that references itself directly ($ref to '#') creates a cyclic reference; the factory should eventually overflow the call stack, resulting in a StackOverflowError.
A file URI that points to a location that does not exist must be rejected with an IllegalArgumentException.
When the classpath location resolves to a directory rather than a file, the factory should throw an IllegalArgumentException because a schema document cannot be read from a directory.
